emulator.name: mGBA
emulator.bundle_provenance: Build GBA GDB Debugger Bundle workflow artifact

experiments.trigger: Boot with the supplied copied 8-KiB save image.

observations.instrumentation_gap: Block 0x1F4 was crossed while reconnecting the RSP client; the surrounding payload-loop sequence was 0x1F3 then 0x1F5.

experiments.conclusion: Runtime confirms the known boot header reads and the payload loop ending at block 0x3EE. This single boot scenario does not prove the tail unused by every subsystem.

experiments.trigger: Continue boot after the copied save failed retail validation.
experiments.conclusion: The invalid-save path attempted repeated writes to the three header blocks only. Exact retry semantics remain bounded by the existing Task 5 analysis.

experiments.trigger: At the initialized title state, derive the payload buffer through *[0x03000198] + 0x168C, seed all 0x1F60 bytes, invoke 0x08045198 manually, and dump the result.

observations.custom_slot_mapping: first 32 padding pairs, sparse offsets 0x02F2 through 0x0467

experiments.conclusion: The repeated two-byte tails are confirmed serializer/deserializer padding. The first 32 pairs hold one 64-byte SU8C slot inside the original payload checksum and transaction, so Task 8 no longer requires direct EEPROM-tail writes.

experiments.trigger: Press Start on the title screen before the main menu appears.

observations.screen_after_return: Main menu with NEW GAME selected

experiments.conclusion: 0x08064E10 participates in main-menu initialization or rendering. Selecting NEW GAME did not call it again, so it is not the final creator interception site.

experiments.trigger: Press A while NEW GAME is selected on a blank-save main menu.
experiments.conclusion: The branch at 0x080652F8 is the confirmed New Game path. The four-byte BL at 0x080652FA is the first practical creator interception site.

experiments.trigger: Run an 8-MiB research image whose guarded BL at 0x080652FA targets the checked expansion module at 0x08400000, then force the already-confirmed branch from an initialized title-menu state to avoid nondeterministic UI timing.
experiments.conclusion: Runtime confirms that the guarded retail BL reaches the expansion module with the original descriptor index and correct return address. Full call-through and return tracing was not completed because mGBA 0.10.5 repeatedly stalled when resuming from a software breakpoint at the expansion entry; static disassembly independently confirms the wrapper calls 0x08066390 and pops PC.

experiments.trigger: Select NEW GAME and advance through the initial bedroom dialogue.
experiments.conclusion: The opening dialogue's Tyson text does not pass through the candidate protagonist lookup during the observed segment. The Enter name descriptor is not part of the initial New Game sequence.

remaining_runtime_gates: hook the retail serializer after its normal writes and before checksum calculation
hook the retail load path after validation and deserialization
verify one SU8C slot survives three complete retail save/load cycles
prove no unrelated high-level routine mutates the selected payload padding pairs
trigger the existing Enter name descriptor with live UI input and inspect its allocated buffer
trace full native wrapper call-through and return with a debugger that resumes reliably from expansion breakpoints
trigger player sprite and portrait lookup paths
trigger all player-side Bit Chip consumers
